reason_not_in.cursor: hub reads the context size from Claude Code's transcript files, and Cursor does not write them.

does: Tells a chat or an agent when its context gets big, because every step reads all of it again. It never stops a call.

children.does: Asks an agent to hand back at the next safe point when its context passes a set size, and again after each gap.
The context size, in tokens, of an agent's first reminder.
How many more tokens until the agent's next reminder.
Asks the main chat to give bigger reading to agents when its context passes a set size, and again after each gap.
The context size, in tokens, of the main chat's first reminder.
How many more tokens until the main chat's next reminder.
Asks an agent to hand back after many steps, even when its context is still small.
The step count of an agent's first step reminder.
How many more steps until the next step reminder.
Lets an agent's brief move its first reminder with a line such as "Hand-back point: 180k".
The highest point a brief may set, in tokens.
After an agent's context is compacted, tells it where its full transcript is, so it can find what the summary left out.
Agents whose model name starts with one of these, such as claude-opus, get no hand-back reminder. They still get the compaction note.
